description: The full breakdown of one commercial by id: idea, logline, tagline, product, audience, every credit by role (director, agency, production company, DP, editor, music, post, sound, VFX), every award (show, year, level, category), craft numbers (shots, average shot length, cuts per minute, when the product / brand / emotional peak / end card land), the script with timings, and the shot list (caption, tags, still and clip per shot).
name: get_commercial
